meta.title: Repeat tool breaker
meta.description: Break stuck agent turns: repetitive tool calls, runaway loops, and consecutive execution failures.

en.allowPrivateHostsHint: Whether loopback and RFC1918 private IP addresses can be fetched by curl.
en.blockLocalHttpHint: Extend the block to loopback and private addresses. Off: a local fetch is ordinary work, and web_fetch_file reaches local addresses too when "Fetch with curl" is on.
en.blockShellHttpHint: Refuse a shell command that fetches over HTTP and send the model to web_fetch_file instead.
en.convergeAfterHint: Consecutive refusals of one target before the span that keeps retrying it is compacted away. A denial can be retried forever; compaction removes what it retries from.
en.convergeFloorHint: The window never shrinks below this, so the escalation stays predictable.
en.convergeReliefHint: Ratio the window shrinks by after each round, in (0, 1]. At 0.5 the sequence is 10, 5, 3, 2, 2 — a model that keeps reoffending is managed harder each time.
en.cookieJarHint: Share cookies across fetches within the same session.
en.description: Interrupts a stuck turn: repeats of the same call, and runs of consecutive failures.
en.failLimitHint: Consecutive failures before the call is refused outright.
en.failWarnAtHint: Consecutive failures before the advisory that says to stop retrying.
en.fetchFileDescription: Fetch remote URL content to workspace files, returning only the file path to the model.
en.fetchWithCurlHint: ON by default. RISK: curl saves ANY content type (PDF, image, archive), follows redirects off-origin, shares cookies between fetches of one session, and reaches anything the shell can reach — loopback and RFC1918 included. Turn OFF to fetch through the platform web service instead: text pages only, no cross-origin redirects, and no private addresses.
en.maxBytesHint: Maximum body size in bytes to save (default 8MB).
en.outputDirHint: Directory where fetched files are saved, relative to the workspace root.
en.readOnly: This deployment serves these settings read-only.
en.saveFailed: The Host refused part of the change. Drafts were kept; check the logs.
en.shellHttpBlockHint: Comma-separated commands the block refuses, such as curl and wget. An interpreter program naming a request API is refused too.
en.summarizeAtHint: Repeats before the call is asked to summarize its progress first.
en.timeoutMsHint: Timeout for curl downloads in milliseconds (default 30,000ms).
en.title: Repeat tool breaker
en.unavailable: These settings are unavailable in this deployment.
en.warnAtHint: Repeats of one call before the light advisory that says to change approach.
